about: Lists of values in code (`list<integer>`, `list<text>`, `list<decimal>`, `list<bool>`), as every runtime gives them. `xs[i]` reads or sets item i, counted from 1. A position outside the list fails with exactly `there is no item <i> in a list of <n>`. `random(max)` is an engine's, compiled to WebAssembly: see conformance/clarity-engines.json.
